thread:
rachel: quick note — example mono + pnpm + Next edge failed on CI: bundler can't resolve @redwood/sdk export. Works locally.

rachel: error: 
Could not resolve 'node_modules/@redwood/sdk' from '/workspace/apps/site/src/edge.ts' 

tom: same hitting us. pnpm .pnpm symlink layout confuses esbuild/rollup used by edge.

erin: our short fixes: 1) add "module" pointing to dist/index.mjs in SDK pkg.json 2) use next.config.js transpilePackages ['@redwood/sdk'] 3) or alias to node_modules/@redwood/sdk/dist/index.mjs

rachel: tried alias, fixed runtime, but TS/LSP still complained about types.

tom: add explicit "types":"dist/index.d.ts" and consider a top-level tiny wrapper package that re-exports files (helps CI builders).

erin: alternative .npmrc: public-hoist-pattern=@redwood/* — hoists package so builders find package.json. Tradeoffs: affects hoisting.

infra-bot: Created ticket CI-901: "pnpm workspace -> edge bundle exports/type resolution" (priority: P2)

rachel: filing a small example repo and a doc snippet for DX onboarding, will link fixes. thanks!
